travel.title: IndiGo to Discontinue All Widebody Operations, End Norse Atlantic Lease
travel.excerpt: India's largest airline will switch Mumbai-Amsterdam to A321XLR and suspend London Heathrow service until its own Airbus A350s arrive, citing geopolitical disruptions.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers in the US and UK face disruptions as IndiGo's ambitious long-haul expansion hits turbulence, with London Heathrow service suspended indefinitely and route changes affecting diaspora travel plans.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Danube Hits Record Lows, Stranding Cruise Ships and Threatening Energy Across Central Europe
travel.excerpt: Europe's second-longest river has dropped to unprecedented levels in Hungary, Serbia, and Romania, forcing cruise cancellations, grounding a Viking ship, and pushing Hungary toward a nuclear plant shutdown.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers planning European river cruises this summer face widespread itinerary disruptions and cancellations on the Danube and Rhine.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Cordelia Cruises Eyes Mangaluru as Next Port of Call in Fleet Expansion Push
travel.excerpt: Waterways Leisure Tourism, India's only listed domestic cruise operator, is evaluating New Mangalore Port for future cruise services as it prepares to nearly triple fleet capacity by 2028.
travel.image_caption: New Mangalore Port, which Cordelia Cruises is eyeing as its next port of call for Indian coastal routes.
travel.nri_angle: Cordelia's Indian-centric cruise experience and potential Mangaluru embarkation point offer NRI travellers, especially those with ties to coastal Karnataka, a new way to explore India by sea.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: India's Inbound Tourism Problem: Overseas Marketing Budget Slashed to ₹3.5 Crore
travel.excerpt: India's overseas tourism promotion allocation has collapsed from ₹542 crore in 2019 to ₹3.5 crore in FY27, leaving the country's inbound recovery lagging behind competitors while outbound travel booms.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs who promote India as a travel destination to friends and colleagues find the country lacks the institutional marketing that competing destinations deploy.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: SkyDrive and Suzuki Deepen India eVTOL Push with Kineco Manufacturing Pact
travel.excerpt: Japan's SkyDrive has partnered with Indian composite manufacturer Kineco to build parts for its SD-05 air taxi, adding to Suzuki's growing role in bringing eVTOL technology to Indian cities.
travel.nri_angle: The SkyDrive-Suzuki-India partnership could create new aerospace manufacturing jobs in India and bring air taxi services to congested Indian cities.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Partners With Ministry of Tourism to Boost Incredible India Globally
travel.excerpt: The MoU will leverage Air India's five-continent network and the government's Incredible India initiative to drive co-branded marketing, transit tourism, and trade engagement.
travel.image_caption: Air India has partnered with the Ministry of Tourism to promote Incredible India across its global network
travel.nri_angle: Improved transit tourism at Delhi and Mumbai hubs and loyalty programme tie-ups could benefit NRIs transiting through or visiting India.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Dubai's 'Invite' Scheme Offers $800 in Perks to Revive Post-War Tourism
travel.excerpt: UAE residents who nominate overseas visitors arriving before October 31 can unlock hotel stays, attraction tickets, and dining deals worth over AED 3,000 — part of Dubai's aggressive push to rebuild its tourism brand after the Iran conflict.
travel.nri_angle: Over 700,000 Indian nationals in Dubai can use the programme to bring family from India during peak VFR season, with visa-on-arrival eligibility simplifying the process.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Turnaround Could Take a Decade, Tata Sons Chief Warns as Losses Double to $2.3 Billion
travel.excerpt: Tata Sons Chairman N. Chandrasekaran extends the airline's transformation timeline to five to ten years, citing supply-chain disruptions, legacy systems, and the fallout from last year's fatal crash.
travel.nri_angle: NRI travelers face reduced Air India options on key North American, European, and Australian corridors during the extended turnaround, though new aircraft deliveries from 2027 promise improved service.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Visa Cuts 2,600 Jobs as AI Reshapes Payments Industry
carousel.excerpt: The payments giant is slashing 7% of its workforce, primarily in technology and product teams, as artificial intelligence accelerates changes across the financial services sector. The cuts come as Indian employees account for a significant share of Visa's tech workforce.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian tech professionals make up a significant share of Visa's engineering workforce in the US and India, and H-1B holders face a 60-day window to find new sponsorship or leave the country after a layoff.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India Demands Global Scrutiny of Pakistan's Crackdown in PoK as Death Toll Mounts
carousel.excerpt: More than 32 people killed in clashes as Islamabad bans protest coalition under anti-terror laws, with India and rights groups calling for a UN investigation.
carousel.nri_angle: Kashmiri diaspora communities in the US and UK closely monitor the PoK crisis, with the escalating violence fueling both diplomatic engagement and community activism abroad.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Netflix's 'Best of the Best' Puts South Asian Dance Culture Center Stage
carousel.excerpt: Maitreyi Ramakrishnan and Priyanka Kedia lead the Hasan Minhaj-penned Bollywood-fusion dance comedy, arriving on Netflix on September 18.
carousel.image_caption: Maitreyi Ramakrishnan stars as Maya in Netflix's Best of the Best, a comedy set in the world of competitive Bollywood-fusion dance
carousel.nri_angle: The film centers on collegiate Bollywood-fusion dance, a distinctly diasporic cultural institution on American campuses, and features a predominantly South Asian cast.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Geneva to Host Youngest-Ever World Chess Championship as Gukesh Defends Title Against Sindarov
carousel.excerpt: FIDE confirms Switzerland will stage the November-December showdown between India's 20-year-old world champion and Uzbekistan's 20-year-old challenger in what will be chess history's youngest title match.
carousel.nri_angle: Gukesh's title defense is a landmark event for India's chess community and the global Indian diaspora; AICF plans viewing events across diaspora hubs
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Perplexity AI Loses Bid to Dismiss Reddit's Data Scraping Lawsuit
carousel.excerpt: A Manhattan federal judge ruled that Reddit can press forward with copyright claims against the AI search startup and three data-scraping companies.
carousel.image_caption: Perplexity AI CEO Aravind Srinivas. A federal judge has denied the company's motion to dismiss Reddit's data scraping lawsuit
carousel.nri_angle: The ruling could reshape the economics of AI training and affect Indian-founded AI startups that rely on web-scraped data for their models.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Bond Selloff Sends 30-Year Yield to 19-Year High as Fed Credibility Wavers
carousel.excerpt: Three FOMC dissenters wanted a rate hike, and the bond market's verdict on Chairman Warsh's inflation stance was swift and brutal.
carousel.nri_angle: Rising U.S. bond yields push mortgage rates higher, directly affecting Indian Americans' home-buying costs, while potentially drawing investment away from emerging markets including India.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
